ASSESSMENT

Diagnosis: Feline lower urinary tract obstruction, recently unblocked.

Differential Diagnosis: Feline lower urinary tract disease (FLUTD) including idiopathic cystitis, urolithiasis, urethral plugs, urinary tract infection.
